sam: Noticing a weird spike: ~85 GPUs marked as 'reserved' but pods stay Pending with AttachVolumeTimeout. Concentrated us-west3 racks (racks 6-8).
anya: Same. Node events show short NIC flaps ~30s then Ready, reservation finalizers hang. kube-controller-manager logs: `error: failed to remove finalizer for Reservation xyz` repeatedly.
brad: Could be the same attach/detach race we saw last quarter but on a different kubelet build. Any chance this is the new attach-detach timeout param we rolled?
ops-carol: Confirmed config drift: us-west3 got the 1.26.4 kubelet image two nights ago. Canary didn't show issues but scale was small.
sam: Quick probe: `kubectl get reservation -o wide | grep Pending | wc -l` -> 42 entries; many tied to node labels `gpu-rack=r6|r7|r8`.
anya: Cost note: if these remain for 8h, ~ $3.6k wasted (onboarding team estimate). Adding `orphaned_gpu_hourly_cost` to the alert makes sense.
brad: Short-term mitigation options: 1) targeted descheduler eviction (ops) 2) reservation controller CRD reconcile bump to force finalizer removal (risky) 3) temporarily disable `preferReservedScore` so scheduler prefers unreserved capacity.
ops-carol: I'll run a cautious descheduler sweep limited to `topology.kubernetes.io/zone=us-west3` + label `reservation-state=stuck` starting with 5 pods. Command: ```kubectl -n kube-system run descheduler-one-off --image=descheduler:stable -- /bin/descheduler --policy-file=/policies/evict-stuck.yaml```
anya: Please watch for cascade: evicting GPU workloads can trigger gang preemptions. Start tiny.
brad: For medium-term I'd like to prototype a scheduler-side "pin_shed" reclaimer: it would mark reservation CRDs as reclaimable after N attach failures and emit an event rather than evict immediately. We can A/B behind feature flag.
scheduling-bot: Noted: scheduling flag `enablePinShed` set to false in prod. Suggest enabling in west3-canary for 2h after descheduler run.
deploy-bot: Created alert `gpu.reservation.orphaned` P2, paging eng-platform-ops, dashboard link: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/8400
ops-carol: Descheduler batch 1: 5 pods evicted -> reclaimed 6 GPUs in 12m. No cascading preempt observed. Rolling another batch of 15 in 20m.
anya: Telemetry: reclaim rate now ~18 GPUs/hr after first two batches. If that holds, we avoid more invasive steps.
brad: I'll draft a minimal PR for `pin_shed` logic (controller side) and a lightweight metric `reservation_reclaim_requests_total`. Posting RFC in #eng-docs today.
sam: Good. If reclaim rate dips below 10 GPUs/hr we should prepare a kubelet rollback plan for us-west3. Ops, can you own the rollback runbook?
ops-carol: I can. I'll also add a temporary SLO for scheduler scoring to deprioritize reserved nodes for 1h.
anya: One more ask: add finance contact to the alert so cost owners get visibility (cc: finance-ops).
scheduling-bot: Canary rollout for kubelet attach timeout tweak scheduled at 1719004400 in west3-canary cluster. I'll post results. :robot_face:
sam: Thanks. Loop back in 30m with reclaim delta. :thumbsup:
